summary: The Brownfields Revitalization for a Better Tomorrow Act amends the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 to modify brownfields revitalization funding, grant and loan limits, application criteria, and oversight provisions.

affected_groups.effect: Gain access to expanded funding categories, higher grant and loan maximums, and possible matching share waivers if located in small communities or disadvantaged areas.
Receive dedicated technical assistance grants to help secure funding and benefit from waived matching share requirements.
Must maintain, update annually, and publicly share inventories of brownfield sites where grant-funded activities occurred, alongside receiving reauthorized state assistance funding.

key_provisions: Expands eligible entities for brownfields funding by adding section 501(c)(6) organizations.
Increases the remediation grant and loan limit to $1,000,000 for each site, and raises multipurpose brownfields grants to $2,000,000.
Allows grant or loan recipients to use up to 10 percent of awarded amounts for demolition activities subject to Administrator approval.
Waives matching share requirements for eligible entities located in small communities or disadvantaged areas.
Authorizes appropriations of $123,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031 to carry out the brownfields subsection.
missing_information: The exact total federal budget impact outside of the authorized appropriation figures listed.
Specific definitions or criteria for 501(c)(6) organizations beyond the tax code reference.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Brownfields Revitalization for a Better Tomorrow Act amends the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 to modify brownfields revitalization funding, grant and loan limits, application criteria, and oversight provisions.
summary_detail.significance: The bill adjusts funding caps, broadens entity eligibility, and alters grant prioritization for cleaning up contaminated properties, alongside mandating regular audits and studies.

title: Brownfields Revitalization for a Better Tomorrow Act
